TRADE DESCRIPTIONS ACT 2011

TRADE DESCRIPTIONS (CERTIFICATION AND MARKING OF HALAL FEES)
(AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 69(2) (c) of the
Trade Descriptions Act 2011 [Act 730], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Trade Descriptions
(Certification and Marking of Halal Fees) (Amendment) Regulations 2018.

 (2) These Regulations come into operation on 23 October 2018.

Amendment of regulation 2
2. The Trade Descriptions (Certification and Marking of Halal Fees)
Regulations 2011 [ P.U. (A) 432/2011 ], which are referred to as the "principal
Regulations" in these Regulations, are amended in regulation 2—

 (a) by inserting after the word "under" the words "subparagraph 7(1)"; and

 (b) by inserting after the words "[ P.U. (A) 431/2011]" the words "and for  related
matters".

Substitution of Schedule
3. The principal Regulations are amended by substituting for the Schedule the
following Schedule:
